source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    source = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 4]
    marker = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 6]
    if not source or not marker:
        return out
    rmin = min(r for r, c in source)
    rmax = max(r for r, c in source)
    cmin = min(c for r, c in source)
    cmax = max(c for r, c in source)
    sr = sum(r for r, c in source) / len(source)
    sc = sum(c for r, c in source) / len(source)
    mr = sum(r for r, c in marker) / len(marker)
    mc = sum(c for r, c in marker) / len(marker)
    if abs(mr - sr) >= abs(mc - sc):
        if mr >= sr:
            mapped = [(rmax + 1 + (rmax - r), c) for r, c in source]
        else:
            mapped = [(rmin - 1 - (r - rmin), c) for r, c in source]
    else:
        if mc >= sc:
            mapped = [(r, cmax + 1 + (cmax - c)) for r, c in source]
        else:
            mapped = [(r, cmin - 1 - (c - cmin)) for r, c in source]
    for r, row in enumerate(out):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value == 6:
                out[r][c] = 0
    for r, c in mapped:
        if 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]):
            out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
